title: Hexactra run trace

formatVersion.description: Version of this file format: 2 since findings were added (a version 1 file has no `findings`)

partial.description: True for a run that was live (queued, running, waiting for its person) when it was exported

version.description: The console version that wrote the file

applied.description: Always true: there is no unmasked export

patternsVersion.description: Version of the sensitive-text pattern table (docs/runs.md, "What is masked")

hits.description: How many matches of each pattern the export masked; patterns with none are left out

origin.description: Where the run was started from: web (the console), android, cli, api, mcp (an AI app), schedule, system

id.description: The OAuth client id; null for an unverified MCP client name

name.description: The display name at the time the run started

verified.description: False: a name an MCP client gave itself over a personal access token

anyOf.description: The AI app that started the run; null when it was not started by an app

traceIds.description: The OpenTelemetry trace ids of the run's jobs (32 hex characters each), oldest first, the newest 100: one trace per job. Empty with the telemetry slice off. Find them in the deployment's trace collector.

host.description: The machine the run used; `name` null when the fabric could not be asked

confirmedActions.description: Steps the owner confirmed that the run carried out (#540)

costUsd.description: A lower bound while costKnown is false

activeMs.description: Time spent working, waits for a person excluded

modelMs.description: E54.0: time spent waiting for the model, measured per call; absent for a run from before it was measured

modelsServed.description: E54.0: the models that served the calls, as provider:model

web.description: What the run did on the web (E50.7); absent when it made no web call

estimatedSearchCostUsd.description: An ESTIMATE (searches times the provider's cost per call); not part of costUsd, which is the AI cost

outputs.description: What the run returned (E39.5): the task's outputs as they were when the run started, with their values, masked (a sensitive output is `[hidden]`). Null for a run without outputs; absent from files written before outputs existed.

currency.description: ISO 4217, or null when the page gave none

value.description: text, number, date and datetime (ISO), url and choice: a string or number; boolean: a boolean; money: `{ amount, currency }`; null: not found. A sensitive output is the string `[hidden]`.

ok.description: The value was returned and valid (an optional output left empty is ok)

note.description: Why a value is missing or was refused ("Not found", "Not a number"); null when ok

outputsComplete.description: Whether every output was returned and valid; null when the run has no outputs or has not finished

startTier.description: The tier a run starts on.

maxTier.description: The highest tier a run may escalate to when it stalls. Never below `startTier`.

allowProviderFallback.description: Use the tier's fallback model when the provider errors or rate-limits.

pins.description: Optional per-policy model override per tier. Each pin must name an enabled model that supports tools and vision.

fast.description: Model that replaces the fast tier for runs under this policy: `provider:modelId` or a bare model id. `null` or absent uses the tier's own definition.

standard.description: Model that replaces the standard tier for runs under this policy: `provider:modelId` or a bare model id. `null` or absent uses the tier's own definition.

frontier.description: Model that replaces the frontier tier for runs under this policy: `provider:modelId` or a bare model id. `null` or absent uses the tier's own definition.

models.description: Which models a run uses, and how it moves between tiers.

maxActions.description: Most browser actions a run may take. `null` means unlimited.

maxModelCalls.description: Most model round trips a run may make. `null` means unlimited.

maxActiveMinutes.description: Most active minutes a run may use (time waiting for a person does not count); 7 days at most when set. `null` means unlimited.

maxInputTokens.description: Most input tokens a run may send. `null` means unlimited.

maxOutputTokens.description: Most output tokens a run may receive. `null` means unlimited.

maxCostUsd.description: Most a run may cost in US dollars. `null` means unlimited.

maxWebCalls.description: Most web searches and page reads (web_search, web_fetch) a run may make. Reaching it does not stop the run: the next web call is refused and the agent uses the browser. `null` means unlimited.

warnAtPercent.description: Warn the owner when any set budget reaches this percentage.

budget.description: What a run may spend. Every limit may be unlimited; stall detection stays on regardless. Chat runs show these limits but are not stopped by them.

maxConsecutiveFailures.description: Failed actions in a row that count as a stall.

maxRepeatedAction.description: The same action repeated this many times counts as a stall.

noProgressActions.description: Actions without visible progress that count as a stall.

onStall.description: What to do on a stall: nudge the model then escalate a tier, escalate at once, ask a person, or fail the run.

stall.description: Stall and loop detection. Always on.

screenshotsKept.description: Recent screenshots kept in the model context.

pruneBatch.description: How many old tool results are pruned together once the context grows.

callsPerChunk.description: Model calls per chunk; the model tier only changes between chunks.

actionsPerReply.description: E54.1: actions one model reply may carry on an unchanged page (fill fields, read, then one action that may change the page). Absent or 1: one, as before. The run stops a reply at the first action that may change the page, fails or asks a person.

observationChars.description: Most characters of one page observation sent to the model.

connectionReadMessages.description: Most mail messages a run may read through the owner's connections (E39.7). Default 25.

connectionReadChars.description: Most characters of content a run may read through the owner's connections: mail bodies, documents, sheets, events (E39.7). Default 200000.

context.description: Context efficiency: how much the model sees each round.

spec.description: An agent policy: model tiers, budgets, stall detection and context settings.

policy.description: The agent policy the run ran under, as snapshotted at its start; null before its first step

effective.description: The limits the run is held to, fixed at its start: the policy budget clamped by the deployment ceilings. `null` is unlimited. Active time is in minutes, cost in USD.

used.description: What the run has used so far, in the same units (active time includes the stretch in progress).

percent.description: Percent of each limit used, one decimal; `null` for an unlimited budget.

source.description: Where each limit came from: the `policy`, or the deployment `ceiling` that clamped it. `null` when unlimited.

costKnown.description: False when a call could not be priced: `used.cost` is then "at least".

enforcement.description: `hard`: a used-up budget ends the run. `soft`: a chat run (trigger `chat`), whose owner is present: its limits are shown and warned about, never enforced (#537).

over.description: The budgets at or over their limit, in check order. A soft-budget run keeps working past them.

anyOf.description: The run budget: `null` on a run that has not started or that was snapshotted before budgets were enforced.

calls.description: Model calls on this tier; null when the run used several tiers (calls are counted per run)

models.description: The tiers the run used, in order, with their models

kind.description: action | handoff | finish | error | note | routing | guidance | end (see `GET /runs/{id}`)

args.description: The stored, redacted arguments, masked again

value.description: Masked; absent when the value is withheld (a secret, a sign-in)

fields.description: A form question only (E40.2): each field the owner filled

value.description: Masked; absent for a sensitive field

question.description: The question this step asked or answered, masked (#541); null for any other step

moment.description: The key moment the picture records

masked.description: How many regions the extension masked in the picture

note.description: Why a key moment has no picture; null when it has one

bytes.description: Size of the stored image; null with `screenshots=none` or when it could not be read

data.description: The masked image, base64. Only with `screenshots=embed`.

anyOf.description: The masked trace picture of a step (#541); null for a step that records no key moment

findings.description: Version 2: the run's findings (E52.6), computed from its steps with no model and masked, as `GET /runs/{id}/diagnostics` answers them; absent in a version 1 file

code.description: What kind of finding it is

detail.description: One or two sentences, facts only

seqFrom.description: The first step it is about, or null

seqTo.description: The last step it is about, or null

stepsSpent.description: Steps attributable to it; 0 when not applicable

chat.description: The messages of the run's conversation (a chat run); empty for any other run

description: A run trace file: everything about a run that is safe to share, masked. Never the transcript, a token, a withheld answer or an AI app's grant or limits.
